columns.name: tagline
columns.label: Tagline
columns.help: One short line under the business name, e.g. Hair, nails and skincare in Jumeirah.

columns.name: logo
columns.label: Logo
columns.help: Optional. A wide logo on a transparent or white background; it replaces the business name in the header and on receipts.

columns.name: hero_image
columns.label: Banner photo
columns.help: Optional. The main photo of your home page, e.g. your salon or a treatment room. modern, classic, rounded: shown next to the tagline. heritage, atelier: fills the screen behind the tagline (wide and calm, 2000 px).

columns.name: story
columns.label: Story
columns.help: Optional. One or two sentences about your business, shown under the banner, e.g. who you are and how you work.

columns.name: story_image
columns.label: Story photo
columns.help: Optional. With the heritage and atelier fonts: a photo near the end of the home page, next to your address and WhatsApp link, e.g. a treatment room or your products. Portrait photos work best.

columns.name: brand_color
columns.label: Brand colour
columns.help: Your main colour as a hex code, e.g. #7A3E48 for rosewood, #1F4D3A for palm green, or #1F1B17 (deep ink) and #000000 (black) with the heritage and atelier fonts. Buttons and highlights use it; text on it turns white or dark by itself.

columns.name: font
columns.label: Font
columns.help: modern: clean. classic: serif headings, for salons and spas. rounded: friendly, for kids' classes. heritage: Arabian luxury, ivory and gold. atelier: modern luxury in black and white. heritage and atelier use the luxury layout (centred name, full-width photo, story). All have Arabic.

columns.name: whatsapp
columns.label: WhatsApp number
columns.help: International format, e.g. +971501234567.

columns.name: trn
columns.label: VAT TRN
columns.help: Your 15-digit Tax Registration Number. When set, receipts become tax invoices.

columns.name: opens
columns.label: Opens at
columns.help: 24-hour time, e.g. 10:00.

columns.name: closes
columns.label: Closes at
columns.help: 24-hour time on the same day, e.g. 21:00. The last appointment ends by this time.

columns.name: closed_days
columns.label: Closed days
columns.help: Weekdays without appointments as numbers separated by commas: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday, 2 Tuesday, 3 Wednesday, 4 Thursday, 5 Friday, 6 Saturday. Leave empty when open every day.

columns.name: deposit_percent
columns.label: Online deposit (%)
columns.help: Part of the price paid by card when booking. 0: nothing is paid online. 100: the full price is paid online.

columns.name: pay_at_venue_enabled
columns.label: Pay at the venue
columns.help: Lets customers book without paying online.

columns.name: cancellation_hours
columns.label: Free cancellation until (hours before)
columns.help: Customers can cancel on the site until this many hours before the start.

columns.name: services
columns.label: Services
columns.help: The # of each service this person does, separated by commas, e.g. 1,2. Leave empty for all services.

columns.name: age_group
columns.label: Who it is for
columns.help: For example Ages 8 to 12, or Adults.

columns.name: weekday
columns.label: Weekday
columns.help: 0 Sunday, 1 Monday, 2 Tuesday, 3 Wednesday, 4 Thursday, 5 Friday, 6 Saturday.

columns.name: time
columns.label: Start time
columns.help: 24-hour time, e.g. 16:00.

columns.name: start_date
columns.label: First session
columns.help: YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for a class that runs every week and can be joined any time.

columns.name: sessions
columns.label: Sessions in the term
columns.help: How many weekly sessions the term price covers. Not used for monthly billing.

columns.name: capacity
columns.label: Seats
columns.help: Enrolments are refused when all seats are taken. A seat is free again when its enrolment is cancelled or marked completed.

columns.name: price
columns.label: Price (AED, incl. VAT)
columns.help: For the term, or per month when billing is monthly.

columns.name: billing
columns.label: Billing
columns.help: term: one payment for the term (the deposit rules apply). monthly: paid by card every month until the customer stops; leave First session empty so the class runs every week.

columns.name: item
columns.label: Booked
columns.help: The service or class, as it was named when booked.

columns.name: participant
columns.label: Participant
columns.help: Who attends the class, e.g. the child.

columns.name: date
columns.label: Date
columns.help: YYYY-MM-DD, UAE time. For a class: the first session attended.

columns.name: time
columns.label: Start
columns.help: HH:MM, UAE time.

columns.name: paid_amount
columns.label: Paid online (AED)
columns.help: What the customer has paid by card, less refunds. Monthly enrolments add each month.

columns.name: status
columns.label: Status
columns.help: Pending waits for the card payment. Only pending and confirmed bookings keep their time or seat: cancel a booking here to free it. Cancelling refunds what was paid by card and emails the customer; confirmed, no_show and completed also email them, and so does a new date, time or staff member.

columns.name: refunded_amount
columns.label: Refunded (AED)
columns.help: Refunded to the card so far. Set by the app.

columns.name: refunds
columns.label: Refunds by payment
columns.help: Set by the app: payment id and amount refunded.

columns.name: billing
columns.label: Billing
columns.help: Classes only: monthly enrolments are paid by card every month.

columns.name: sub_status
columns.label: Monthly payments
columns.help: Monthly enrolments: overdue when a monthly payment failed (Stripe retries); ending when stopped at the end of the month paid.

columns.name: paid_until
columns.label: Paid until
columns.help: Monthly enrolments: end of the month paid (UTC), the next payment date.

templates.css:
<style>
/* Renoxium template design system: shared base. The theme (brand colour, font, logo) comes from theme() in lib and sits on <html>. */
:root{color-scheme:light;--brand:#334155;--on-brand:#fff;--brand-text:#334155;
--paper:#fff;--ink:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 14%,#121212);--ink-2:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 74%,#fff);
--line:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 12%,#fff);--line-strong:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 28%,#fff);
--well:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 5%,#f4f3f1);--brand-soft:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 8%,#fff);
--brand-hover:color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand) 84%,#000);--danger:#a3261d;--danger-soft:#fbeeec;
--r-control:8px;--r-media:4px;--r-sheet:12px;
--fs-14:.875rem;--fs-16:1rem;--fs-18:1.125rem;--fs-22:1.375rem;--fs-28:1.75rem;--fs-36:2.25rem;--fs-48:3rem;
--font-text:"IBM Plex Sans","IBM Plex Sans Arabic",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif;--font-display:var(--font-text);--display-boost:1}
[data-font=classic]{--font-display:"Markazi Text","Noto Naskh Arabic",Georgia,serif;--display-boost:1.16}
[data-font=rounded]{--font-text:"Rubik",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif}
/* Luxury type pairs (font = heritage or atelier; theme() then sets data-style=luxury). Arabic falls through to the Arabic face. */
[data-font=heritage]{--paper:#fbf8f2;--well:#f0eadf;--accent:#a08048;--font-display:"Cormorant Garamond","Amiri",Georgia,serif;--font-text:"Jost","Noto Naskh Arabic",system-ui,sans-serif}
[data-font=atelier]{--paper:#fff;--well:#f3f2ef;--accent:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 40%,#fff);--font-display:"Bodoni Moda","Noto Naskh Arabic",Didot,Georgia,serif;--font-text:"Hanken Grotesk","Noto Kufi Arabic",system-ui,sans-serif}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font-text);font-size:var(--fs-16);line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;overflow-wrap:break-word}
body:lang(ar){line-height:1.75}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);text-wrap:balance}
h1,h2{font-family:var(--font-display)}
h1{font-size:calc(var(--fs-28) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.015em}
h2{font-size:calc(var(--fs-22) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h3{font-size:var(--fs-18);line-height:1.35}
h1:lang(ar),h2:lang(ar),h3:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.45}
@media(min-width:720px){h1{font-size:calc(var(--fs-36) * var(--display-boost))}}
p{margin:0}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:.22em}
a:hover{color:var(--brand-text)}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand-text);outline-offset:2px}
.num,.price{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums}
.price{white-space:nowrap}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.small{font-size:var(--fs-14)}.quiet{color:var(--ink-2)}
.wrap{--gutter:16px;max-width:1180px;margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gutter)}
@media(min-width:720px){.wrap{--gutter:24px}}
@media(min-width:1080px){.wrap{--gutter:32px}}
.skip{position:absolute;inset-inline-start:-9999px;top:8px}.skip:focus{inset-inline-start:16px;z-index:50;background:var(--paper);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:var(--r-control)}

/* Top bar, header, footer */
.bar{background:var(--well);font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.bar .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px 16px;min-height:36px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.langs{display:flex;align-items:center}
.langs a{text-decoration:none;padding:6px 0;color:var(--ink-2)}
.langs a+a{margin-inline-start:12px;padding-inline-start:12px;border-inline-start:1px solid var(--line-strong)}
.langs a[aria-current]{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.site-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;background:var(--paper);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.site-head .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;min-height:64px}
.mark{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--fs-22) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.2;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink)}
.mark img{max-height:40px;width:auto}
.acts{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;font-size:var(--fs-16)}
.acts a{text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:44px}
.acts a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.count{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;min-width:22px;height:22px;padding-inline:6px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1}
.count[hidden]{display:none}
.site-foot{margin-top:72px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
.site-foot .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px 40px;padding-block:32px 40px}
.site-foot strong{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;font-size:var(--fs-16)}
.foot-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 24px}
.foot-links form{margin:0}

/* Page heads, buttons, notices */
.page-head{padding-block:32px 24px}
.page-head p{margin-top:8px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:var(--r-control);border:1px solid transparent;font:inherit;font-weight:500;line-height:1.2;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;background:var(--brand);color:var(--on-brand)}
.btn:hover{background:var(--brand-hover);color:var(--on-brand)}
.btn.line{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line-strong)}
.btn.line:hover{border-color:var(--ink);background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.btn.wide{width:100%}
.linkbtn{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:inherit;color:inherit;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:.22em;cursor:pointer}
.linkbtn:hover{color:var(--brand-text)}
.alert{background:var(--danger-soft);color:var(--danger);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-control);margin-bottom:24px}
.notice{background:var(--brand-soft);padding:20px;border-radius:var(--r-sheet);margin-bottom:8px}
.notice p+p{margin-top:4px;color:var(--ink-2)}
.empty{padding-block:48px 24px;max-width:34em}
.empty p{margin:8px 0 24px;color:var(--ink-2)}

/* Forms: labels above fields, grouped in sections */
.group{border:0;padding:0;margin:0 0 32px;min-width:0}
.group>legend{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:600;font-size:calc(var(--fs-22) * var(--display-boost));line-height:1.3;padding:0;margin-bottom:16px}
.field{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px}
.field>label,.lab{font-size:var(--fs-14);font-weight:500}
.hint{font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2)}
input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--r-control);min-height:48px;padding:11px 14px;width:100%}
textarea{min-height:88px;resize:vertical}
[dir=rtl] input[dir=ltr]{text-align:right}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--brand-text);outline:2px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--brand-text) 35%,transparent);outline-offset:0}
input[type=radio],input[type=checkbox]{width:20px;height:20px;min-height:0;margin:0;accent-color:var(--brand-text);flex:none}
@media(min-width:720px){.pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0 16px}}
.choice{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;padding:14px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong);border-radius:var(--r-control);margin-bottom:8px;cursor:pointer}
.choice input{margin-top:3px}
.choice:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--brand-text);background:var(--brand-soft)}
.choice .hint{display:block}

/* Totals and key-value lists */
.rows{display:grid}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;padding-block:6px}
.row>:last-child{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums lining-nums;text-align:end;white-space:nowrap}
.row.total{border-top:1px solid var(--line-strong);margin-top:8px;padding-top:14px;font-weight:600;font-size:var(--fs-18)}
.row.sub{font-size:var(--fs-14);color:var(--ink-2);padding-top:0}
.facts{margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.facts>div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(6.5em,30%) 1fr;gap:4px 16px;padding-block:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.facts dt{font-weight:500}.facts dd{margin:0;color:var(--ink-2)}
.facts dd span{display:block}
.sheet{background:var(--well);border-radius:var(--r-sheet);padding:20px}
.sheet h2{font-size:var(--fs-18);font-family:var(--font-text);letter-spacing:0;margin-bottom:12px}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
@media print{.bar,.site-head,.site-foot,.noprint,.buybar,.skip{display:none!important}body{font-size:11pt}a{text-decoration:none}.sheet{background:none;padding:0}}

/* Luxury style (data-style=luxury): paper instead of white, no radii, hairlines only, light display type, small tracked labels in Latin. */
[data-style=luxury]{--ink-2:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 68%,var(--paper));--line:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 11%,var(--paper));--line-strong:color-mix(in oklab,var(--ink) 30%,var(--paper));
--brand-soft:var(--well);--r-control:0;--r-media:0;--r-sheet:0;--label:.75rem;--label-ar:.9375rem}
[data-style=luxury] body{line-height:1.65}
[data-style=luxury] main>.wrap{padding-bottom:120px}
[data-style=luxury] :is(h1,h2,.tname,.line-name,.o-id,.mark){font-variant-numeric:lining-nums}
[data-style=luxury] .wrap{max-width:1360px}
[data-style=luxury] body:lang(ar){font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.9}

.intro.has-photo .wrap{display:grid;gap:28px;align-items:center;padding-bottom:0}

.tile{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}

@media(min-width:720px){[data-style=luxury] .tiles{gap:80px 28px;margin-top:40px}}
@media(min-width:1080px){[data-style=luxury] .tiles{gap:96px 40px}}
[data-style=luxury] .tile{gap:4px;text-align:center;align-items:center}
[data-font=atelier] .tile{text-align:start;align-items:flex-start}
[data-style=luxury] .tile:hover .tname{text-decoration:none}
[data-style=luxury] .well{aspect-ratio:3/4;margin-bottom:20px;width:100%}
[data-style=luxury] .tile .well img{transition:transform 1.4s cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1)}
[data-style=luxury] .tile:hover .well img{transform:scale(1.035)}
[data-style=luxury] .tname{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:1.375rem;line-height:1.2}
@media(min-width:720px){[data-style=luxury] .tname{font-size:1.5rem}}
[data-style=luxury] .tname:lang(ar){font-size:1.375rem;line-height:1.6}
[data-font=atelier] .tname{font-size:1.25rem}
[data-style=luxury] .tmeta{justify-content:center;font-size:.8125rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
[data-font=atelier] .tmeta{justify-content:flex-start}
[data-style=luxury] .tmeta .price{font-size:inherit;color:var(--ink-2)}
[data-style=luxury] .tmeta:lang(ar){font-size:.9375rem;letter-spacing:0}
[data-style=luxury] .classes{margin-top:48px;column-gap:56px}
[data-style=luxury] .classes a{grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1fr);padding-block:28px;column-gap:24px}
[data-style=luxury] .classes .well{aspect-ratio:3/4}
[data-style=luxury] .c-name{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1.2}
[data-style=luxury] .c-name:lang(ar){font-size:1.375rem;line-height:1.6}
[data-style=luxury] .c-price .price{font-weight:400}
[data-style=luxury] .visit{display:grid;background:var(--well);margin-top:120px}
@media(min-width:900px){[data-style=luxury] .visit{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:center}}
[data-style=luxury] .visit-img img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover}
[data-style=luxury] .visit-text{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:20px;padding:64px 24px 72px;text-align:center}
[data-style=luxury] .visit-text p{max-width:22em;color:var(--ink-2)}
[data-style=luxury] .visit-text h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,3.6vw,2.75rem)}[data-style=luxury] .visit-text h2:lang(ar){font-size:clamp(1.75rem,3vw,2.375rem)}
[data-font=atelier] .visit-text{justify-items:start;text-align:start;padding-inline:clamp(24px,6vw,96px)}
main:has(>.visit:last-child)+.site-foot{border-top:0}
/* Service and class pages */
[data-style=luxury] .pdp-media .well{aspect-ratio:4/5;margin:0}
[data-style=luxury] .pdp-info{padding-top:8px}
[data-style=luxury] .pdp-info h1{margin-bottom:12px}
[data-style=luxury] .pprice{font-size:var(--fs-16);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.04em}
[data-style=luxury] .pprice:lang(ar){letter-spacing:0;font-size:var(--fs-18)}
[data-style=luxury] .desc{margin-top:28px;font-size:1.0625rem}
[data-style=luxury] .opts{margin-top:36px}
[data-style=luxury] .opt-list{gap:0 28px}
[data-style=luxury] .opt{padding:10px 0 8px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0}
[data-style=luxury] .opt:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:none;background:none}
[data-style=luxury] .opt:has(input:focus-visible),[data-style=luxury] .day:has(input:focus-visible){outline:1px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:4px}
[data-style=luxury] .days{gap:4px}
[data-style=luxury] .day{border:0;border-bottom:1px solid transparent;border-radius:0;width:58px}
[data-style=luxury] .d-n{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:1.625rem}
[data-style=luxury] .d-wd,[data-style=luxury] .d-m{font-size:.8125rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
[data-style=luxury] .day:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:none;background:none}
[data-style=luxury] .day:has(input:disabled){opacity:.45}
[data-style=luxury] .slot{border-color:var(--line);border-radius:0;background:transparent;letter-spacing:.04em}
[data-style=luxury] .slot:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
[data-style=luxury] .slot[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper);border-color:var(--ink);box-shadow:none;font-weight:400}
[data-style=luxury] .picker .group>legend{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:300;font-size:1.5rem}
[data-font=atelier] .picker .group>legend{font-weight:400}
[data-style=luxury] .buybar .btn{min-height:56px}
[data-style=luxury] .pdp .facts{margin-top:32px;font-size:var(--fs-14)}
[data-style=luxury] .facts>div{padding-block:16px}
@media(max-width:899px){
 [data-style=luxury] .pdp{gap:32px}
 [data-style=luxury] .buybar{background:var(--paper);padding-block:10px}
 [data-style=luxury] .buybar-sum .price{font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:var(--fs-18);font-weight:400}
}
@media(min-width:900px){[data-style=luxury] .pdp{gap:88px;padding-top:56px}[data-style=luxury] .pdp-info{max-width:480px;padding-top:40px}}
[data-style=luxury] .o-id,[data-style=luxury] .b-item{font-family:var(--font-display);font-weight:400;font-size:1.375rem}
[data-style=luxury] .o-id:lang(ar){font-size:1.25rem}
[data-style=luxury] .btn:disabled{background:transparent;border-color:var(--line);color:var(--ink-2)}
</style>

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists what this business offers: appointment services (duration, price) and group classes (weekday, time, sessions, price for the term, seats left). Prices are in AED and include VAT. Each entry has the url of the page where it is booked.

params.name: lang
params.description: en (default) or ar for Arabic names

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Free start times for one appointment service on one date, in UAE time. Booking and paying happen on the service's page (book_at); this tool only reads.

tools.name: business_info
tools.description: The business's opening hours, address, payment methods, online deposit, cancellation rule and WhatsApp contact.
